ValidationRule.description: If a Task is assigned to the DMS Queue, or the Task Template indicates it will be assigned there, only members of the DMS Queue can change the status to Completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), NOT($Permission.DMS_Task_Approval), OR( Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = "DMS", Task_Template_Queue__c = "DMS" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This task is (or is set to be) assigned to the DMS Queue. Only DMS Queue members can set the status to Completed.
